resources.string: Your contacts will be alerted in %1$d s unless you tap I\'m OK
If you don\'t answer, an SMS with your location goes to %1$d contact(s).
No SMS could be sent (no contacts or no permission). Call for help if you need it.
Simulation: this would have gone to %1$d contact(s). Nothing was sent.
🆘 RideScreen AA: %1$s may have crashed their motorbike and hasn\'t answered for %2$d s. Location: %3$s (%4$s). Automatic message.
🆘 RideScreen AA, update: %1$s still hasn\'t answered (first alert after %2$d s). Location now: %3$s (%4$s). Automatic message.

While you ride, the phone watches for a hard impact followed by the bike and the phone staying still. Then it sounds an alarm for 60 s on the phone and the watch. If nobody taps \"I\'m OK\", it texts up to 3 contacts with a map link to where you are, and again 5 minutes later. It never calls emergency services by itself.
The alarm will sound and the countdown will start, on the watch too. Nothing will be sent: at the end you\'ll see the message that would have gone out.
A real SMS marked as a test will be sent to: %1$s
This is not a certified safety device: it can miss a crash or raise a false alarm. Tell your contacts about it so a message doesn\'t scare them. SMS cost what your plan charges.
In this version (Google Play) the app can\'t send SMS: it only sounds the alarm. This is not a certified safety device.
Allow full-screen alerts so the alarm shows over the lock screen (tap here)
